items.title: Symphony Of Communities
items.summary: What happens when community bands from across Ontario come together on one stage? Find out at Symphony of Communities: When Ontario Plays as One ! Hosted by the Mississauga Pops Concert Band, this lively afternoon concert is part of the Canadian Band Association (Ontario) Community Band Weekend and showcases the energy, passion, and camaraderie of musicians from across the province. Come celebrate community, connection, and great music.

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Hotel California
items.summary: HOTEL CALIFORNIA, the original Eagles tribute is bringing their full production to the Living Arts Centre Mississauga Friday October 23. This is without question the best live Eagles performance you will see this side of the Las Vegas Sphere. For over three decades, HOTEL CALIFORNIA has been re-creating the legendary sound of THE EAGLES, and thrilling audiences all over the world.

items.title: Solidaridad Tango in Concert
items.summary: Experience the passion, virtuosity, and irresistible rhythms of live tango! On Friday, October 23, the Chamber Music Society of Mississauga presents Solidaridad Tango , North America’s original all-woman, diversity-affirming tango ensemble, for an electrifying evening of music and dance.

items.title: Video Game Live Expo (VGLX)
items.summary: Calling all Pokémon Trainers! VGLX is packed with Pokémon activities all weekend long, from scavenger hunts and mini-games to crafts, photo ops, card collecting and more. Whether you want to catch ’em all, make something of your own or hunt for your next favourite card, there’s something for Pokémon fans of every age.

items.summary: Join us for a captivating Bharatanatyam dance performance!

items.title: Sing Pitch Perfect with Deke Sharon and Splüsh
items.summary: Join the legendary Deke Sharon , the Father of Contemporary A Cappella, for an unforgettable interactive singing experience featuring a hit song from the beloved Pitch Perfect movie franchise. Learn directly from the Music Director behind all three blockbuster Pitch Perfect films as Deke guides you through an all-a-cappella performance of the fan-favorite anthem, Since U Been Gone . With his expert coaching, you'll be singing confidently alongside fellow Pitch Perfect enthusiasts in no time.
